familyRules: Group upstream project, monorepo, forks, related versions and all derivatives together.
Shared generated template/build recipe creates a connected family group; no cross-split derivatives.
Phase 1 and all visible Phase 2 development material are excluded from held-out selection.

independence.status: Pending human appointment, blind evidence labeling, family review and freeze. No held-out outputs or grading created.

labelAuthorship: Existing Phase 1 and new original inert conformance labels are implementing-agent constructions; public release captures are unlabeled. No independent label authorship is claimed.
freeze: Bind labels/rationale/citation locations, family/split seed/method, rights/input hashes, code/configuration/grader hashes before outputs; custodian records one grading attempt. Keep failures; tuning requires fresh family-separated reserve.
